discussion.key_messages: - There is a Moderate Risk for Excessive Rainfall (level 3 of 4) across portions of southern Utah, as a surge of moisture brings widespread rainfall across the region. A Flood Watch is in effect for much of southern and east central Utah late tonight through Sunday evening. - Accumulating mountain snow is expected across all Utah mountains Sunday through Monday morning. Upwards of 12" of snow is expected above 9000 feet, and 3-6" of snow down to around 7000 feet. Upper elevations of the Cottonwoods and western Uintas may see localized accumulations 18-24". - Cool, dry, and stable conditions will temporarily build in Tuesday, with another weak storm system expected during the Wendesday-Thursday timeframe.

posts.title: It's Time to Pray for Snow
posts.excerpt: Early snow often becomes weak snow so the snow-safety cognoscenti often tell me they'd prefer the snow hold off until November and then come in spades. Right now, the first part of that wish looks like it will come…
